name: Circle of the Moon
desc: Circle of the Moon: a druid subclass. Hand-written summary, not the book text.

features.name: Combat Wild Shape
features.desc: Use Wild Shape as a bonus action. Spend a spell slot to heal while in beast form.

features.name: Circle Forms
features.desc: Wild Shape into stronger beasts than normal, up to CR 1 at level 2.

features.name: Primal Strike
features.desc: Your beast-form attacks count as magical.

features.name: Elemental Wild Shape
features.desc: Spend two uses of Wild Shape to become an elemental.
